description: This file defines a low-level API for caching HTTP objects, including structures for representing cacheable objects and their results, and functions for determining cacheability, expiration, and related cache control logic.

classes.name: Object
classes.description: Represents a potentially cachable HTTP object with request and response headers, directives, status code, and timestamps.

classes.name: ObjectResults
classes.description: Holds the results of cacheability checks, including reasons, warnings, expiration time, and errors.

methods.name: CachableRequestObject
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP request is cacheable based on its method and directives.

methods.name: CachableResponseObject
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP response is cacheable based on headers, status, and directives.

methods.name: CachableObject
methods.description: Performs combined cacheability checks on an Object.

methods.name: ExpirationObject
methods.description: Calculates the expiration time for a cacheable Object based on headers and directives.

methods.name: UsingRequestResponse
methods.description: Evaluates cacheability based on an HTTP request and response headers.

methods.name: UsingRequestResponseWithObject
methods.description: Evaluates cacheability and returns the parsed Object along with reasons, warnings, and expiration time.

methods.name: hasFreshness
methods.description: Determines if a response has explicit freshness directives.

methods.name: cachableStatusCode
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP status code is cacheable by default.
